indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_attempt_id_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("attempt_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_cart_id_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("cart_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_command_id_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("command_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_commerce_transaction_id_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("commerce_transaction_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_deleted_at" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("deleted_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_live_order_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("order_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND order_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_campaign_state" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("campaign_id", "state") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_reconcile_due" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("state", "next_reconcile_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND next_reconcile_at IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_active_lease" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution" ("state", "lease_until") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'commerce_pending'

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_business_stream
checks.expression: (outbox_stream_started AND business_version >= 1 AND business_changed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT outbox_stream_started AND business_version = 0 AND business_changed_at IS NULL)
checks.definition: check (((outbox_stream_started AND business_version >= 1 AND business_changed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT outbox_stream_started AND business_version = 0 AND business_changed_at IS NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_authorized_fence
checks.expression: completion_authorized_epoch IS NULL OR (state = 'commerce_pending' AND completion_authorized_epoch = lease_epoch)
checks.definition: check ((completion_authorized_epoch IS NULL OR (state = 'commerce_pending' AND completion_authorized_epoch = lease_epoch)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_lease_pair
checks.expression: (lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL) OR (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: check (((lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL) OR (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_lease_state
checks.expression: (state = 'commerce_pending') = (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: check (((state = 'commerce_pending') = (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_success_result
checks.expression: state NOT IN ('commerce_succeeded', 'completed') OR (order_id IS NOT NULL AND last_error_code IS NULL)
checks.definition: check ((state NOT IN ('commerce_succeeded', 'completed') OR (order_id IS NOT NULL AND last_error_code IS NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_failed_result
checks.expression: state NOT IN ('commerce_definitive_failed', 'canceled') OR (order_id IS NULL AND last_error_code IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: check ((state NOT IN ('commerce_definitive_failed', 'canceled') OR (order_id IS NULL AND last_error_code IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_unknown_result
checks.expression: state <> 'commerce_unknown' OR (order_id IS NULL AND last_error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_reconcile_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: check ((state <> 'commerce_unknown' OR (order_id IS NULL AND last_error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_reconcile_at IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_order_state
checks.expression: order_id IS NULL OR state IN ('commerce_succeeded', 'completed')
checks.definition: check ((order_id IS NULL OR state IN ('commerce_succeeded', 'completed')))

indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_item_execution_id" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution_item" ("execution_id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_execution_item_deleted_at" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution_item" ("deleted_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_item_campaign_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution_item" ("execution_id", "campaign_item_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_item_variant_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_execution_item" ("execution_id", "variant_id")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_control_deleted_at" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_control" ("deleted_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event_deleted_at" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("deleted_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_aggregate_version_unique" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("aggregate_type", "aggregate_id", "aggregate_version")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_due" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("status", "available_at", "occurred_at", "id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_recovery" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("status", "lease_until", "id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'publishing'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_dead" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("dead_lettered_at", "id") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'dead_letter'

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_head" ON "flash_sale_checkout_outbox_event" ("aggregate_type", "aggregate_id", "aggregate_version") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 'published'

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_counts
checks.expression: attempt_count >= 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0 AND redrive_count >= 0 AND (max_attempts IS NULL OR (max_attempts >= 1 AND max_attempts <= 100)) AND (published_lease_epoch IS NULL OR published_lease_epoch >= 1)
checks.definition: check ((attempt_count >= 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0 AND redrive_count >= 0 AND (max_attempts IS NULL OR (max_attempts >= 1 AND max_attempts <= 100)) AND (published_lease_epoch IS NULL OR published_lease_epoch >= 1)))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_bounded_identifiers
checks.expression: char_length(event_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND char_length(aggregate_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND char_length(aggregate_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR char_length(lease_owner) BETWEEN 1 AND 255) AND (published_by IS NULL OR char_length(published_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 255) AND (last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$')
checks.definition: check ((char_length(event_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND char_length(aggregate_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND char_length(aggregate_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR char_length(lease_owner) BETWEEN 1 AND 255) AND (published_by IS NULL OR char_length(published_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 255) AND (last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$')))

checks.name: CK_flash_sale_checkout_outbox_status_fields
checks.expression: (status = 'pending' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'publishing' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'published' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_by IS NOT NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NOT NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'dead_letter' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: check (((status = 'pending' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'publishing' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'published' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_by IS NOT NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NOT NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'dead_letter' AND attempt_count >= 1 AND max_attempts IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL AND published_lease_epoch IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NOT NULL)))
